parameters.content:
## iOS Shortcut → Notion Capture Inbox (UPSERT)

Same webhook creates on first call, PATCHes on every call after.

**Auth** — native Header Auth on the webhook node. The Shortcut must send
`X-Capture-Token` matching the *Capture Token* credential. n8n rejects with 403
before the workflow runs, so refused calls leave no execution.

**Partial updates** — a key absent from the body is left alone in Notion; `null`
clears it. `Status` and `Source` are written on create only, so a hand-edited
Status survives a re-POST.

**Blocks** — rewritten never; appended on update only when the body sets
`appendBlocks: true`.

Database ID lives in **Config** and nowhere else.

nodes.name: Capture Webhook
nodes.notes: POST target for the iOS Shortcut. Header Auth is enforced by n8n before the workflow runs.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: The only node to edit when pointing this at a different database.

nodes.name: Normalize Capture
nodes.notes: Builds createProperties (with defaults) and updateProperties (present keys only). Maps device onto the four existing select options. Stamps every datetime with an explicit UTC offset so Notion does not read it as UTC.

nodes.name: Valid Payload?
nodes.notes: Bad payloads get a 400 instead of a silent failure.

nodes.name: Respond — Invalid
nodes.notes: Tells the Shortcut exactly which field was missing.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ page_size: 1, filter: { property: 'Capture ID', rich_text: { equals: $json.captureId } } }) }}

nodes.name: Find Existing Capture
nodes.notes: Idempotency guard: the Shortcut retries on flaky cell service.

nodes.name: Already Captured?
nodes.notes: True means this captureId is already a row.

nodes.name: Update Notion Page
nodes.notes: PATCH properties only. Page children are never rewritten here.

nodes.name: Append On Update?
nodes.notes: Blocks append only when the body sets appendBlocks: true.

nodes.name: Append Update Blocks
nodes.notes: Opt-in only; default update path appends nothing.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, status: 'updated', captureId: $('Normalize Capture').item.json.captureId, pageId: $('Find Existing Capture').item.json.results[0].id, pageUrl: $('Find Existing Capture').item.json.results[0].url }) }}

nodes.name: Respond — Updated
nodes.notes: Replaces Respond — Duplicate.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ parent: { database_id: $('Normalize Capture').item.json.notionDatabaseId }, icon: { emoji: '🎙️' }, properties: $('Normalize Capture').item.json.createProperties, children: $('Normalize Capture').item.json.children }) }}

nodes.name: Create Notion Page
nodes.notes: Raw API call, not the Notion node: only this can write a dynamic number of transcript blocks.

nodes.name: Has Overflow?
nodes.notes: Only long transcripts need a second call.

nodes.name: Append Overflow Blocks
nodes.notes: Notion caps page-create at 100 children; this appends the rest.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, status: 'created', captureId: $('Normalize Capture').item.json.captureId, pageId: $('Create Notion Page').item.json.id, pageUrl: $('Create Notion Page').item.json.url }) }}

nodes.name: Respond — Created
nodes.notes: The Shortcut can open pageUrl straight from the response.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: false, status: 'notion_error', captureId: $('Normalize Capture').first().json.captureId, message: $json.error?.message ?? $json.message ?? 'Notion request failed' }) }}

nodes.name: Respond — Notion Error
nodes.notes: Surfaces the Notion failure instead of a bare 500.
